_: THE FIVE ROUTES — defined educational products, not quantities of time.
Every route carries the whole of qualification.json: the same sixty
modules, the same ten person-marked assignments a level, the same
examination, the same double marking, moderation and conferral. What
differs is the support a learner receives on the way to it, and each
difference is listed here as a component with its own driver.
Hours appear below only where the thing being specified is a
commitment of teaching — a seminar timetable, a tutorial entitlement —
because that is what the College must staff. They are the cost basis
of the route. They are never the unit in which the route is sold, and
no page of the plan divides a price by them.

independent.name: WEC-LC Independent
independent.for: The academically capable, self-directed learner who wants the qualification and will study on their own schedule.
independent.promise: The complete qualification: curriculum, learning environment, assessment, examination, second marking, moderation, conferral, registry and verification, with defined academic support.

adviserHoursPerLevel.s: Placement, progression advice and a substantive reply to any academic question

guided.name: WEC-LC Guided
guided.for: The learner who wants to study with others, to a timetable, with a teacher setting the pace.
guided.promise: Everything in Independent, and structured teaching in a scheduled seminar cohort, academic guidance, monitored progress and written feedback on every assignment beyond the mark.

seminarHoursPerLevel.s: Two hours of scheduled seminar teaching a week across the twelve teaching weeks

sectionCap.s: A seminar cohort is capped at fourteen

feedbackMinutesPerAssignment.s: Structured written feedback on each assignment, beyond the mark

monitoringHoursPerLevel.s: Progress monitored by the seminar teacher, with an intervention where a learner falls behind

tutored.name: WEC-LC Tutored
tutored.for: The learner who wants individual academic attention: a named adviser, personal feedback and tutorials.
tutored.promise: Everything in Guided, in a smaller seminar cohort, with individual tutorials, a named academic adviser, personalised feedback and a structured progress review at every level.

seminarHoursPerLevel.s: Two hours of scheduled seminar teaching a week across the twelve teaching weeks, as on Guided

tutorialHoursPerLevel.s: Individual tutorials with a named instructor across the level

feedbackMinutesPerAssignment.s: Personalised feedback on each assignment, keyed to the learner's own progress record

adviserHoursPerLevel.s: A named academic adviser for the whole qualification

reviewHoursPerLevel.s: A structured progress review at the end of each level

executive.name: WEC-LC Executive
executive.for: The senior professional whose English must carry authority, and whose calendar cannot follow a published timetable.
executive.promise: The qualification delivered as an executive educational service: a closed professional cohort, senior academic staff, private scheduling, individual academic planning, the English of leadership, and high-touch administration and priority support.

seminarHoursPerLevel.s: The qualification's seminar programme, taught in a closed professional cohort

leadershipStrandHoursPerLevel.s: The English of leadership — presentation, negotiation, correspondence and the conduct of meetings — taught in the same cohort; supplementary to the qualification and not assessed differently

tutorialHoursPerLevel.s: Individual sessions scheduled around the learner's professional obligations

adviserHoursPerLevel.s: An individual academic plan agreed at entry and reviewed at every level

oversightHoursPerLevel.s: Senior academic oversight of the learner's route

administrationHoursPerLevel.s: Diary negotiation, priority response and the coordination an executive relationship requires
administrationHoursPerLevel.u: administrative hours per learner per level

strandAuthoringHoursPerLevel.s: Authoring the leadership strand once for each level, before the route first opens

bespoke.name: WEC-LC Bespoke
bespoke.for: The individual whose professional field, schedule and purpose need a programme built around them alone.
bespoke.promise: The qualification delivered one to one by senior academic staff, with material written to the holder's own professional domain, entirely private scheduling, and dedicated administration.

tutorialHoursPerLevel.s: The whole teaching programme delivered one to one

feedbackMinutesPerAssignment.s: Feedback written for the holder's own professional context

adviserHoursPerLevel.s: An individual academic plan, agreed and reviewed with the holder

authoringHoursPerLevel.s: Material written to the holder's professional domain — curriculum cost that cannot be shared with anyone
authoringHoursPerLevel.u: academic hours per learner per level

administrationHoursPerLevel.u: administrative hours per learner per level
